item.title: [LU-20149] ost-pools: crash due to NULL pointer dereference in qsd_op_end()
item.description:
This issue was created by maloo for Marc Vef <mvef@whamcloud.com>

This issue relates to the following test suite run: https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sets/6d18dbfa-d1d4-4ee0-ac64-960c843fc693

Test session details:
clients: https://build.whamcloud.com/job/lustre-reviews/124049 - 5.14.0-503.40.1.el9_5.x86_64
servers: https://build.whamcloud.com/job/lustre-reviews/124049 - 5.14.0-503.40.1_lustre.el9.x86_64
